info.title: InformerOnline API
info.description: Move your app forward with the InformerOnline API First make sure you have a valid Informer account, then click here to create your API key. ALL DATES ARE IN FORMAT 'YYYY-mm-dd'! If anything in this documentation is not clear enough or you require assistance related to the API, you can contact support at api@informer.eu

get.description: Get details about the administration linked to this API key, including address, contact information, tax IDs and active modules.
Get a single relation by ID. Includes contacts, tags and custom fields (free fields).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the relation.

put.description: Update an existing relation by ID. Not all fields are required; you can send only the fields you want to update.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the relation to update.

get.description: Get a paginated list of all relations. For each relation the contacts, tags and subtypes are included.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default = 1).

parameters.name: records
parameters.description: Number of records per page (default = 20).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search string. Searches in company name, street, city and relation number.

parameters.name: last_edit
parameters.description: Only return relations edited after this date (format: YYYY-mm-dd).

post.description:
Create a new relation. The relation_number is optional; if omitted or 0, a new number is generated. The fields sales_invoice_template_id and payment_condition_id are optional; default values will be used if not provided.

When relation_type is 0 (company): company_name is required, firstname/surname are forbidden.
When relation_type is 1 (private): firstname and surname are required, company_name is forbidden.

get.description: Get a single sales invoice by ID, including all line items.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the sales invoice.

put.description: Update an existing sales invoice by ID. The invoice must be in concept status.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the sales invoice to update.

get.summary: Get a list of sales invoices
get.description: Get a paginated list of all sales invoices with their line items.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default = 1).

parameters.name: records
parameters.description: Number of records per page.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter invoices by status.

parameters.name: last_edit
parameters.description: Only return invoices edited after this date (format: YYYY-mm-dd).

parameters.name: relation_id
parameters.description: Only return invoices for the relation with this ID.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order. Format: field.direction (e.g. date.desc). Available fields: created, name, number, date, amount, invoiceAmountPaid, invoiceAmountOpen.

post.description:
Create a new sales invoice. Use the /invoices/sales/options endpoint first to determine valid combinations of vat_id, ledger_id and vat_option.

Lines can be either regular lines (with qty, amount, vat_id, ledger_id) or info lines (with info=true and description only).

For administrations in Austria (AT) or Germany (DE), the delivery_date field is also required.

404.description: Resource not found (e.g. relation_id does not exist)

get.description: Get the available VAT rates with their compatible ledger accounts and VAT options. Use this endpoint to determine valid combinations of vat_id, ledger_id and vat_option when creating invoices.

200.description: Array of VAT rates with their compatible ledger accounts

get.description: Download the PDF of a sales invoice as a base64-encoded string.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the sales invoice.

404.description: No PDF available for this sales invoice

post.description: Send a sales invoice via email, mark as sent, or send via Peppol. The invoice will be finalized before sending.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the sales invoice to send.

post.description: Upload a file as a document-specific attachment for a sales invoice. The file content must be base64-encoded. Supported types: PDF, PNG, JPEG, GIF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX. Maximum size: 10 MB. The attachment is automatically included when the invoice is sent by email and is preserved when the invoice is updated. Do not reference these IDs in the 'attachments' field of POST/PUT requests; manage them only through this endpoint.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the sales invoice.

422.description: Validation error (missing fields, invalid base64, unsupported type, or file too large)

get.description: Download the file content of an attachment linked to a sales invoice, base64-encoded. Works for both shared library attachments and invoice-specific document attachments, as long as the attachment is linked to this invoice. The file content is only returned by this endpoint, not in the invoice GET response.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the sales invoice.

parameters.name: attachment_id
parameters.description: The ID of the attachment to download.

404.description: Invoice or attachment not found, or file missing from storage

delete.description: Delete a document-specific attachment from a sales invoice. The file is permanently removed from storage.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the sales invoice.

parameters.name: attachment_id
parameters.description: The ID of the attachment to delete.

404.description: Invoice or attachment not found for this invoice
